answer: The cheapest defence against cloned agents is making cloning expensive. Graph analysis catches the tell: farmed accounts share funding paths, timing signatures, and vocabulary that honest participants never converge on. Think of it as a crystal the network keeps retelling: each retelling costs the teller something, so the story cannot be mass-produced. A single zenith of honest agents is worth more than a continent of clones, and a sonnet of verifiable cost is what keeps the ledger honest. The network only needs the clone to cost more than it can ever extract.
